id-20260921-news-1.title: Agrarian Reform Bill Scheduled for DPR Approval on September 22, Single Land Data and One Map Policy to Be Mainstay

segments.src: Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat (DPR) dijadwalkan mengetok palu pengesahan Rancangan Undang-Undang (RUU) Reforma Agraria dalam rapat paripurna pada Selasa, 22 September mendatang.
segments.tr: The House of Representatives (DPR) is scheduled to hammer the approval of the Agrarian Reform Bill (RUU Reforma Agraria) in a plenary meeting on Tuesday, September 22.

segments.src: Rancangan beleid yang disusun dalam 16 bab dan 70 pasal ini digadang-gadang menjadi payung hukum baru bagi penataan kepemilikan dan penggunaan tanah di Indonesia.
segments.tr: This draft bill, structured in 16 chapters and 70 articles, is touted to become a new legal umbrella for organizing land ownership and use in Indonesia.

segments.src: ## Menyasar Persoalan Lama: Sengketa dan Tumpang Tindih Izin
segments.tr: ## Addressing Long-Standing Issues: Disputes and Overlapping Permits

segments.src: Selama bertahun-tahun, sengketa lahan dan tumpang tindih perizinan kerap menjadi sumber konflik yang melibatkan warga, pemerintah daerah, hingga investor.
segments.tr: For years, land disputes and overlapping permits have frequently been a source of conflict involving citizens, local governments, and investors.

segments.src: Ketiadaan basis data pertanahan yang terintegrasi disebut-sebut sebagai salah satu akar masalah, karena data yang tersebar di berbagai kementerian dan lembaga sering kali tidak sinkron satu sama lain.
segments.tr: The absence of an integrated land database is cited as one of the root causes, as data scattered across various ministries and agencies is often out of sync with one another.

segments.src: RUU Reforma Agraria berupaya menjawab persoalan tersebut melalui dua instrumen utama:
segments.tr: The Agrarian Reform Bill seeks to address these issues through two main instruments:

segments.src: - **Basis data agraria tunggal** — sistem pendataan tanah terpadu yang menyatukan informasi kepemilikan, status hak, dan riwayat transaksi lahan di seluruh wilayah.
segments.tr: - **Single agrarian database** — an integrated land data collection system that unites information on ownership, rights status, and land transaction history across all regions.

segments.src: - **Kebijakan satu peta (one map policy)** — penyelarasan peta tematik dari berbagai sektor seperti kehutanan, perkebunan, tata ruang, dan pertambangan ke dalam satu referensi geospasial yang sama.
segments.tr: - **One map policy** — the alignment of thematic maps from various sectors such as forestry, plantations, spatial planning, and mining into a single identical geospatial reference.

segments.src: Dengan kedua instrumen ini, pemerintah berharap potensi tumpang tindih izin antar-sektor dapat dideteksi lebih dini, sehingga sengketa yang selama ini berlarut-larut dapat ditekan.
segments.tr: With these two instruments, the government hopes that the potential for inter-sectoral permit overlaps can be detected earlier, so that disputes that have dragged on can be suppressed.

segments.src: ## Manfaat yang Diharapkan bagi Masyarakat dan Investor
segments.tr: ## Expected Benefits for the Public and Investors

segments.src: Bagi masyarakat, terutama petani dan masyarakat adat, basis data tunggal diharapkan memberi kepastian hukum atas hak atas tanah yang mereka kuasai secara turun-temurun namun belum tercatat secara formal.
segments.tr: For the public, especially farmers and indigenous peoples, the single database is expected to provide legal certainty over land rights that they have controlled for generations but have not been formally recorded.

segments.src: Kejelasan status lahan ini penting untuk mencegah konflik agraria yang kerap muncul akibat klaim ganda.
segments.tr: This clarity of land status is important to prevent agrarian conflicts that frequently arise due to dual claims.

segments.src: Di sisi lain, kalangan pelaku usaha menilai kepastian data pertanahan juga akan mempermudah proses perizinan investasi, khususnya di sektor yang membutuhkan lahan dalam skala besar seperti perkebunan, industri, dan infrastruktur.
segments.tr: On the other hand, business actors consider that certainty of land data will also facilitate the investment licensing process, especially in sectors requiring large-scale land such as plantations, industry, and infrastructure.

segments.src: Proses uji tuntas (due diligence) atas status lahan yang lebih transparan berpotensi memangkas waktu dan biaya yang selama ini kerap membengkak akibat sengketa administratif.
segments.tr: The more transparent due diligence process on land status has the potential to cut time and costs that have often swelled due to administrative disputes.

segments.src: ## Proses Pembahasan di DPR
segments.tr: ## Discussion Process in the DPR

segments.src: Pembahasan RUU ini telah melalui serangkaian rapat kerja antara pemerintah dan Komisi terkait di DPR, termasuk penyerapan masukan dari akademisi, organisasi masyarakat sipil, serta asosiasi pengusaha.
segments.tr: The discussion of this bill has gone through a series of working meetings between the government and relevant Commissions in the DPR, including absorbing input from academics, civil society organizations, and business associations.

segments.src: Sejumlah pasal krusial, seperti mekanisme penyelesaian sengketa dan kewenangan lembaga pengelola basis data, disebut menjadi fokus pembahasan pada tahap akhir sebelum RUU dibawa ke rapat paripurna.
segments.tr: A number of crucial articles, such as the dispute resolution mechanism and the authority of the database management institution, were said to be the focus of discussion in the final stage before the bill is brought to the plenary meeting.

segments.src: Jika disahkan sesuai jadwal, tahap selanjutnya adalah penyusunan peraturan pelaksana berupa peraturan pemerintah dan peraturan turunan lainnya, yang akan mengatur teknis implementasi basis data tunggal dan integrasi kebijakan satu peta di lapangan.
segments.tr: If approved on schedule, the next stage is the drafting of implementing regulations in the form of government regulations and other derivative regulations, which will govern the technical implementation of the single database and the integration of the one map policy in the field.

segments.src: ## Tantangan Implementasi ke Depan
segments.tr: ## Future Implementation Challenges

segments.src: Meski kerangka hukum baru ini membawa optimisme, sejumlah pengamat kebijakan publik mengingatkan bahwa keberhasilan reforma agraria sangat bergantung pada konsistensi implementasi di tingkat daerah.
segments.tr: Although this new legal framework brings optimism, a number of public policy observers remind us that the success of agrarian reform heavily depends on consistent implementation at the regional level.

segments.src: Integrasi data antar-lembaga yang selama ini berjalan lambat perlu dipercepat, sementara kapasitas sumber daya manusia dan infrastruktur teknologi di daerah juga perlu diperkuat agar basis data tunggal dapat berfungsi optimal.
segments.tr: Data integration between agencies that has been running slowly needs to be accelerated, while human resource capacity and technology infrastructure in the regions also need to be strengthened so that the single database can function optimally.

segments.src: Publik kini menanti hasil rapat paripurna sebagai penentu babak baru kebijakan pertanahan nasional, sekaligus menjadi ujian awal atas komitmen pemerintah dan DPR dalam menuntaskan persoalan agraria yang telah lama menjadi pekerjaan rumah bersama.
segments.tr: The public is now awaiting the results of the plenary meeting as a determinant of a new chapter in national land policy, as well as an initial test of the government's and DPR's commitment in resolving agrarian issues that have long been a shared homework.

id-20260921-news-2.title: Indonesia's Foreign Exchange Reserves Rise to US$146.5 Billion as of August 2026, BI States Equal to 5.4 Months of Imports

segments.src: Bank Indonesia (BI) melaporkan posisi cadangan devisa nasional per akhir Agustus 2026 tercatat sebesar US$146,5 miliar, naik dibandingkan posisi akhir Juli 2026 yang sebesar US$145,3 miliar.
segments.tr: Bank Indonesia (BI) reported that the position of national foreign exchange reserves at the end of August 2026 was recorded at US$146.5 billion, an increase compared to the position at the end of July 2026 which was US$145.3 billion.

segments.src: Kenaikan ini menambah rentetan data yang menjadi salah satu indikator penting dalam menilai ketahanan sektor eksternal Indonesia di tengah dinamika perekonomian global.
segments.tr: This increase adds to the series of data that serves as one of the important indicators in assessing the resilience of Indonesia's external sector amid global economic dynamics.

segments.src: ## Faktor Pendorong Kenaikan
segments.tr: ## Driving Factors of the Increase

segments.src: BI menjelaskan bahwa peningkatan cadangan devisa pada periode tersebut terutama didorong oleh dua faktor utama, yaitu penerimaan pajak dan penarikan pinjaman luar negeri oleh pemerintah.
segments.tr: BI explained that the increase in foreign exchange reserves in that period was mainly driven by two main factors, namely tax revenues and the withdrawal of government foreign loans.

segments.src: Penerimaan dari sektor perpajakan turut menopang posisi kas devisa negara, sementara pencairan sebagian pinjaman luar negeri pemerintah juga memberikan tambahan pasokan valuta asing ke dalam cadangan nasional.
segments.tr: Revenues from the taxation sector helped support the state's foreign exchange cash position, while the disbursement of some of the government's foreign loans also provided an additional supply of foreign currency into the national reserves.

segments.src: Di sisi lain, bank sentral juga mencatat adanya faktor penekan, di antaranya kebutuhan pembayaran utang luar negeri pemerintah yang jatuh tempo pada periode berjalan.
segments.tr: On the other hand, the central bank also noted suppressing factors, including the need to pay government foreign debt maturing in the current period.

segments.src: Pembayaran tersebut menjadi bagian dari kewajiban rutin yang harus dipenuhi sehingga turut memengaruhi arus keluar valuta asing, meski secara keseluruhan tidak menghalangi tren kenaikan cadangan devisa bulan ini.
segments.tr: These payments are part of routine obligations that must be met, thus affecting the outflow of foreign currency, although overall it did not prevent this month's upward trend in foreign exchange reserves.

segments.src: ## Setara 5,4 Bulan Impor
segments.tr: ## Equivalent to 5.4 Months of Imports

segments.src: Bank Indonesia menyebut posisi cadangan devisa senilai US$146,5 miliar tersebut cukup untuk membiayai kebutuhan impor dan pembayaran utang luar negeri pemerintah selama sekitar 5,4 bulan.
segments.tr: Bank Indonesia stated that the foreign exchange reserve position of US$146.5 billion is sufficient to finance import needs and government foreign debt payments for about 5.4 months.

segments.src: Angka ini berada di atas standar kecukupan internasional yang umumnya mensyaratkan cadangan devisa setara minimal tiga bulan impor.
segments.tr: This figure is above the international adequacy standard which generally requires foreign exchange reserves equivalent to a minimum of three months of imports.

segments.src: Dengan level tersebut, BI menilai cadangan devisa nasional masih memadai untuk mendukung ketahanan sektor eksternal serta menjaga stabilitas nilai tukar rupiah dari tekanan jangka pendek.
segments.tr: With this level, BI assesses that national foreign exchange reserves remain adequate to support the resilience of the external sector and maintain the stability of the rupiah exchange rate from short-term pressures.

segments.src: Cadangan devisa yang relatif tebal juga memberi ruang bagi otoritas moneter untuk merespons gejolak pasar keuangan apabila diperlukan.
segments.tr: Relatively thick foreign exchange reserves also provide room for monetary authorities to respond to financial market volatility if needed.

segments.src: ## Bayang-Bayang Ketidakpastian Global
segments.tr: ## The Shadows of Global Uncertainty

segments.src: Meski tren cadangan devisa menunjukkan perbaikan, Bank Indonesia mengingatkan bahwa tantangan dari sisi eksternal belum sepenuhnya reda.
segments.tr: Although the foreign exchange reserve trend shows improvement, Bank Indonesia reminded that challenges from the external side have not fully subsided.

segments.src: Dinamika kebijakan moneter di negara-negara maju, pergerakan yield obligasi global, serta sentimen investor terhadap aset-aset pasar berkembang masih berpotensi memicu gejolak pada pasar keuangan domestik, termasuk terhadap pergerakan rupiah.
segments.tr: The dynamics of monetary policy in developed countries, the movement of global bond yields, and investor sentiment towards emerging market assets still have the potential to trigger volatility in the domestic financial market, including towards the movement of the rupiah.

segments.src: Selain itu, kewajiban pembayaran utang luar negeri pemerintah yang bersifat berkelanjutan turut menjadi faktor yang perlu terus dicermati, mengingat dapat memengaruhi arus keluar-masuk valuta asing pada periode-periode berikutnya.
segments.tr: In addition, the obligation to pay government foreign debt which is sustainable is also a factor that needs to be continuously monitored, considering it can affect the inflow and outflow of foreign currency in subsequent periods.

segments.src: ## Komitmen Menjaga Stabilitas
segments.tr: ## Commitment to Maintaining Stability

segments.src: Bank Indonesia menegaskan akan terus memantau perkembangan kondisi eksternal sekaligus berkoordinasi dengan pemerintah dan otoritas terkait guna memastikan stabilitas nilai tukar rupiah dan ketahanan sektor eksternal tetap terjaga.
segments.tr: Bank Indonesia emphasized that it will continue to monitor external condition developments while coordinating with the government and relevant authorities to ensure that the stability of the rupiah exchange rate and the resilience of the external sector are maintained.

segments.src: Langkah ini dilakukan seiring upaya menjaga kepercayaan pasar terhadap fundamental ekonomi domestik.
segments.tr: This step is taken alongside efforts to maintain market confidence in domestic economic fundamentals.

segments.src: Data cadangan devisa ini menjadi salah satu indikator yang rutin dicermati pelaku pasar, karena mencerminkan kemampuan negara dalam memenuhi kewajiban eksternal sekaligus meredam potensi tekanan terhadap nilai tukar di tengah ketidakpastian perekonomian global yang masih berlangsung.
segments.tr: This foreign exchange reserve data is one of the indicators routinely observed by market players, as it reflects the country's ability to fulfill external obligations while dampening potential pressure on the exchange rate amid ongoing global economic uncertainty.

id-20260921-news-3.title: INA Joins China-ASEAN Joint Investment Council, Six Sovereign Wealth Funds Pool Capital in Xiamen

segments.src: ## Platform Investasi Baru Lintas Kawasan Resmi Terbentuk
segments.tr: ## New Cross-Regional Investment Platform Officially Formed

segments.src: Indonesia Investment Authority (INA), lembaga pengelola dana kekayaan negara Indonesia, resmi menjadi bagian dari **China-ASEAN Joint Investment Council (CAJIC)**, sebuah wadah investasi bersama yang baru dibentuk untuk mempererat kerja sama modal antara China dan kawasan Asia Tenggara.
segments.tr: The Indonesia Investment Authority (INA), Indonesia's sovereign wealth management institution, has officially become part of the **China-ASEAN Joint Investment Council (CAJIC)**, a newly formed joint investment platform to strengthen capital cooperation between China and the Southeast Asian region.

segments.src: Peluncuran platform ini berlangsung di sela penyelenggaraan pameran investasi di Xiamen, China, yang selama ini dikenal sebagai salah satu pusat pertemuan pelaku bisnis dan investor dari kawasan Asia-Pasifik.
segments.tr: The launch of this platform took place on the sidelines of an investment exhibition in Xiamen, China, which has long been known as a hub for business players and investors from the Asia-Pacific region.

segments.src: Selain INA, CAJIC turut diikuti oleh lembaga investasi negara dari Malaysia, Thailand, dan Azerbaijan, sehingga total terdapat enam entitas dana kekayaan negara yang menyatukan komitmen dalam kerangka kerja sama ini.
segments.tr: In addition to INA, CAJIC is also joined by state investment institutions from Malaysia, Thailand, and Azerbaijan, bringing a total of six sovereign wealth entities uniting their commitment within this cooperation framework.

segments.src: Pembentukan dewan ini menandai langkah baru dalam upaya memperkuat konektivitas ekonomi antara China dan negara-negara anggota ASEAN, khususnya di tengah dinamika perdagangan dan investasi global yang terus berubah.
segments.tr: The establishment of this council marks a new step in efforts to strengthen economic connectivity between China and ASEAN member states, especially amid constantly shifting global trade and investment dynamics.

segments.src: ## Tujuan Pembentukan CAJIC
segments.tr: ## Objectives of CAJIC's Establishment

segments.src: Berdasarkan keterangan yang beredar dari penyelenggara, CAJIC dirancang bukan sekadar sebagai forum simbolis, melainkan sebagai platform kerja yang mempertemukan tiga elemen utama, yaitu penghimpunan modal bersama, kolaborasi riset ekonomi dan sektor investasi, serta program pelatihan bagi eksekutif lembaga investasi dari berbagai negara anggota.
segments.tr: Based on information circulated by the organizers, CAJIC is designed not merely as a symbolic forum, but as a working platform that brings together three main elements, namely joint capital pooling, economic and investment sector research collaboration, and executive training programs for investment institutions from various member countries.

segments.src: Pendekatan ini diharapkan dapat mempercepat pertukaran pengetahuan sekaligus membuka peluang investasi lintas batas yang lebih terstruktur.
segments.tr: This approach is expected to accelerate knowledge exchange while opening up more structured cross-border investment opportunities.

segments.src: Dengan menyatukan sumber daya dari beberapa dana kekayaan negara sekaligus, CAJIC berpotensi menjadi kanal baru bagi proyek-proyek strategis di sektor infrastruktur, energi, teknologi, hingga rantai pasok industri yang menjadi kepentingan bersama China dan kawasan ASEAN.
segments.tr: By pooling resources from multiple sovereign wealth funds simultaneously, CAJIC has the potential to become a new channel for strategic projects in infrastructure, energy, technology, and industrial supply chains of mutual interest to China and the ASEAN region.

segments.src: ## Posisi Indonesia Investment Authority dalam Kerja Sama Ini
segments.tr: ## Position of the Indonesia Investment Authority in This Cooperation

segments.src: Keikutsertaan INA dalam CAJIC memperluas jejaring kerja sama internasional lembaga yang dibentuk pemerintah Indonesia sejak 2021 tersebut.
segments.tr: INA's participation in CAJIC expands the international cooperation network of the institution established by the Indonesian government since 2021.

segments.src: Selama ini, INA telah menjalin sejumlah kemitraan dengan lembaga investasi global maupun regional untuk menarik aliran modal ke berbagai sektor prioritas di dalam negeri.
segments.tr: So far, INA has established partnerships with global and regional investment institutions to attract capital flows to various priority sectors domestically.

segments.src: Bergabungnya INA ke dalam dewan investasi bersama ini membuka ruang bagi Indonesia untuk turut ambil bagian dalam perumusan arah kerja sama investasi China-ASEAN ke depan, sekaligus memperluas akses terhadap jaringan riset dan program pengembangan kapasitas eksekutif yang ditawarkan melalui platform tersebut.
segments.tr: INA's joining of this joint investment council opens up space for Indonesia to take part in formulating the future direction of China-ASEAN investment cooperation, while expanding access to research networks and executive capacity development programs offered through the platform.

segments.src: ## Konteks Hubungan Ekonomi China-ASEAN
segments.tr: ## Context of China-ASEAN Economic Relations

segments.src: Pembentukan CAJIC berlangsung di tengah upaya berkelanjutan China dan negara-negara ASEAN untuk memperdalam hubungan ekonomi, termasuk melalui berbagai forum perdagangan dan investasi yang rutin digelar di kota-kota seperti Xiamen dan Nanning.
segments.tr: The establishment of CAJIC takes place amid ongoing efforts by China and ASEAN countries to deepen economic relations, including through various trade and investment forums regularly held in cities such as Xiamen and Nanning.

segments.src: Kawasan Asia Tenggara sendiri selama beberapa tahun terakhir menjadi salah satu tujuan investasi yang terus diminati, seiring dengan pertumbuhan populasi kelas menengah, perkembangan infrastruktur digital, dan peralihan sebagian rantai pasok manufaktur ke kawasan ini.
segments.tr: The Southeast Asian region itself has in recent years become one of the most sought-after investment destinations, along with the growth of the middle-class population, digital infrastructure development, and the shift of part of the manufacturing supply chain to the region.

segments.src: Bagi Indonesia, partisipasi dalam forum-forum investasi lintas kawasan semacam ini dinilai sejalan dengan agenda besar menarik investasi asing langsung guna mendukung pembiayaan proyek-proyek pembangunan nasional, tanpa harus bergantung sepenuhnya pada satu sumber modal atau mitra tertentu.
segments.tr: For Indonesia, participation in such cross-regional investment forums is considered aligned with the major agenda of attracting foreign direct investment to support the financing of national development projects, without having to rely entirely on a single capital source or specific partner.

segments.src: ## Langkah Selanjutnya
segments.tr: ## Next Steps

segments.src: Hingga saat ini, rincian teknis mengenai struktur pendanaan, skema tata kelola, dan proyek konkret yang akan digarap melalui CAJIC belum sepenuhnya diumumkan ke publik.
segments.tr: To date, technical details regarding the funding structure, governance scheme, and concrete projects to be undertaken through CAJIC have not been fully announced to the public.

segments.src: Pihak-pihak yang terlibat disebut akan menindaklanjuti peluncuran ini dengan pertemuan lanjutan untuk merumuskan mekanisme kerja sama yang lebih rinci, termasuk kemungkinan proyek percontohan di sektor-sektor prioritas bersama.
segments.tr: The parties involved are said to follow up this launch with subsequent meetings to formulate more detailed cooperation mechanisms, including potential pilot projects in shared priority sectors.

segments.src: Perkembangan ini akan terus dipantau, mengingat potensinya dalam membentuk pola baru kerja sama investasi antara China dan kawasan Asia Tenggara, termasuk peran yang akan dimainkan Indonesia melalui INA dalam jaringan tersebut.
segments.tr: This development will continue to be monitored, given its potential in shaping a new pattern of investment cooperation between China and the Southeast Asian region, including the role Indonesia will play through INA within that network.

id-20260921-intro-retail-3.title: [Retail #3] When Your Distributor and Online Store Fight for the Same Buyer

segments.src: > Konflik antar mitra distribusi bukan tanda saluran yang rusak — itu tanda bahwa kekuatan dan kepentingan di dalamnya belum dikelola.
segments.tr: > Conflict between distribution partners is not a sign of a broken channel — it is a sign that power and interests within it have not been managed.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Produk hampir tidak pernah berjalan sendirian dari pabrik ke tangan pembeli.
segments.tr: Products almost never travel alone from the factory to the buyer's hands.

segments.src: Ada rantai di tengahnya: **produsen → distributor → grosir → pengecer → konsumen**.
segments.tr: There is a chain in the middle: **manufacturer → distributor → wholesaler → retailer → consumer**.

segments.src: Rantai itu disebut **saluran distribusi**.
segments.tr: That chain is called a **distribution channel**.

segments.src: Kuncinya: setiap anggota rantai adalah perusahaan terpisah dengan pembukuan sendiri.
segments.tr: The key: every member of the chain is a separate company with its own bookkeeping.

segments.src: Mereka saling membutuhkan, tetapi tidak berbagi dompet.
segments.tr: They need each other, but they do not share wallets.

segments.src: Produsen ingin volume dan citra merek; distributor ingin perputaran cepat dan margin aman; pengecer ingin harga beli semurah mungkin.
segments.tr: Manufacturers want volume and brand image; distributors want fast turnover and safe margins; retailers want the lowest possible purchase price.

segments.src: Selama tujuannya tidak identik, gesekan adalah hal normal.
segments.tr: As long as their goals are not identical, friction is normal.

segments.src: ### 1. Sumber kekuatan (channel power)
segments.tr: ### 1. Sources of Power (Channel Power)

segments.src: Siapa yang "menang" dalam gesekan biasanya ditentukan oleh sumber kekuatan yang dipegang.
segments.tr: Who "wins" in a friction is usually determined by the source of power they hold.

segments.src: Dalam literatur pemasaran, kekuatan ini umumnya dibagi lima (kerangka klasik French & Raven yang dipinjam ke studi saluran):
segments.tr: In marketing literature, this power is generally divided into five (the classic French & Raven framework borrowed into channel studies):

segments.src: - **Kekuatan imbalan (reward power)** — kemampuan memberi keuntungan: margin lebih besar, rabat kuantitas, prioritas alokasi stok.
segments.tr: - **Reward power** — the ability to provide benefits: larger margins, quantity rebates, priority stock allocation.

segments.src: - **Kekuatan paksaan (coercive power)** — kemampuan memberi kerugian: menunda pengiriman, mencabut wilayah, menghentikan pasokan.
segments.tr: - **Coercive power** — the ability to inflict harm: delaying shipments, revoking territories, stopping supply.

segments.src: - **Kekuatan sah (legitimate power)** — hak yang tertulis dalam kontrak, misalnya kewajiban target pembelian atau standar tampilan toko.
segments.tr: - **Legitimate power** — rights written in contracts, such as purchase target obligations or store display standards.

segments.src: - **Kekuatan keahlian (expert power)** — penguasaan pengetahuan yang tidak dimiliki pihak lain: data penjualan, riset konsumen, teknologi rantai pasok.
segments.tr: - **Expert power** — mastery of knowledge not possessed by other parties: sales data, consumer research, supply chain technology.

segments.src: - **Kekuatan referensi (referent power)** — daya tarik merek; pihak lain *ingin* berasosiasi karena merek itu menaikkan reputasi mereka.
segments.tr: - **Referent power** — brand appeal; other parties *want* to associate because the brand raises their reputation.

segments.src: Yang menarik di ritel modern: kekuatan bergeser.
segments.tr: What is interesting in modern retail: power is shifting.

segments.src: Dulu produsen besar mendikte pengecer kecil.
segments.tr: In the past, large manufacturers dictated to small retailers.

segments.src: Kini jaringan minimarket dan platform e-commerce memegang akses langsung ke jutaan pembeli plus data transaksi, sehingga merek justru harus menyesuaikan diri.
segments.tr: Now, minimarket chains and e-commerce platforms hold direct access to millions of buyers plus transaction data, forcing brands to adapt instead.

segments.src: ### 2. Tiga bentuk konflik saluran
segments.tr: ### 2. Three Forms of Channel Conflict

segments.src: - **Konflik vertikal** — antar tingkat yang berbeda: produsen vs distributor, distributor vs toko.
segments.tr: - **Vertical conflict** — between different levels: manufacturer vs. distributor, distributor vs. store.

segments.src: - **Konflik horizontal** — sesama tingkat: dua distributor menyerobot wilayah, atau dua reseller perang banting harga.
segments.tr: - **Horizontal conflict** — at the same level: two distributors encroaching on territories, or two resellers in a price war.

segments.src: - **Konflik multisaluran** — saluran lama vs saluran baru milik merek yang sama, misalnya jaringan distributor offline berhadapan dengan toko resmi merek di marketplace.
segments.tr: - **Multichannel conflict** — old channels vs. new channels belonging to the same brand, for example offline distributor networks facing the brand's official store in a marketplace.

segments.src: Penyebabnya biasanya berulang: tujuan yang tidak selaras, peran dan hak yang kabur, perbedaan persepsi tentang pasar, dan ketergantungan yang timpang (satu pihak punya banyak alternatif, pihak lain tidak).
segments.tr: The causes are usually repetitive: misaligned goals, blurred roles and rights, differing perceptions of the market, and asymmetric dependence (one party has many alternatives, the other does not).

segments.src: Perlu dicatat, tidak semua konflik merugikan.
segments.tr: It should be noted that not all conflict is harmful.

segments.src: Konflik dalam kadar wajar bisa memaksa perbaikan layanan dan efisiensi.
segments.tr: Conflict in reasonable amounts can force service improvements and efficiency.

segments.src: Yang berbahaya adalah **konflik disfungsional** — ketika energi mitra habis untuk saling menjegal, bukan untuk melayani pembeli.
segments.tr: What is dangerous is **dysfunctional conflict** — when partners' energy is spent blocking each other rather than serving buyers.

segments.src: ### 3. Dari menekan ke bermitra
segments.tr: ### 3. From Pressuring to Partnering

segments.src: Menekan mitra dengan kekuatan paksaan memang cepat, tetapi mahal jangka panjang: mitra terbaik pindah ke pesaing.
segments.tr: Pressuring partners with coercive power is fast, but expensive in the long run: the best partners move to competitors.

segments.src: Karena itu praktik pengelolaan bergerak ke arah kemitraan:
segments.tr: Therefore, management practices are moving toward partnership:

segments.src: - **Tujuan superordinat** — sasaran bersama yang lebih besar dari kepentingan masing-masing, misalnya merebut pangsa kategori dari merek impor.
segments.tr: - **Superordinate goals** — shared objectives larger than individual interests, such as capturing category share from imported brands.

segments.src: - **Kejelasan peran** — kontrak yang menyebut wilayah, kebijakan harga, dan siapa menanggung biaya promosi.
segments.tr: - **Role clarity** — contracts specifying territories, pricing policies, and who bears promotion costs.

segments.src: - **Kompensasi lintas saluran** — mekanisme agar saluran yang "kalah" tetap kebagian nilai.
segments.tr: - **Cross-channel compensation** — mechanisms so that the "losing" channel still receives value.

segments.src: - **Berbagi data dan komunikasi rutin** — rapat kinerja, akses data stok dan penjualan.
segments.tr: - **Data sharing and regular communication** — performance meetings, stock and sales data access.

segments.src: - **Mediasi atau arbitrase** — jalur penyelesaian saat negosiasi buntu, sebelum berakhir di pengadilan.
segments.tr: - **Mediation or arbitration** — resolution paths when negotiations stall, before ending up in court.

segments.src: ## Dalam Keseharian
segments.tr: ## In Daily Life

segments.src: Bayangkan merek keripik singkong asal Bandung, sebut saja **Renyah Nusantara**.
segments.tr: Imagine a cassava chip brand from Bandung, let's call it **Renyah Nusantara**.

segments.src: Sejak 2019 mereka mengandalkan satu distributor untuk Jabodetabek.
segments.tr: Since 2019 they have relied on a single distributor for Greater Jakarta.

segments.src: Alurnya rapi:
segments.tr: The flow is neat:

segments.src: Pabrik jual ke distributor   : Rp 8.000 / pak
segments.tr: Pabrik jual ke distributor   : Rp 8.000 / pak

segments.src: Distributor jual ke warung   : Rp 9.500 / pak
segments.tr: Distributor jual ke warung   : Rp 9.500 / pak

segments.src: Warung jual ke konsumen      : Rp 12.000 / pak
segments.tr: Warung jual ke konsumen      : Rp 12.000 / pak

segments.src: Distributor menanggung gudang di Bekasi, tiga armada, dan piutang ratusan warung.
segments.tr: The distributor handles a warehouse in Bekasi, three fleets, and receivables from hundreds of small shops.

segments.src: Margin Rp 1.500 per pak terasa sepadan.
segments.tr: A margin of Rp 1,500 per pack feels worth it.

segments.src: Lalu merek membuka toko resmi di marketplace dan menggelar flash sale **Rp 9.000 per pak, gratis ongkir**.
segments.tr: Then the brand opens an official store in a marketplace and holds a flash sale for **Rp 9,000 per pack, free shipping**.

segments.src: Penjualan online melonjak, tim pemasaran senang.
segments.tr: Online sales soar, the marketing team is happy.

segments.src: Tetapi di lapangan: konsumen memotret layar ponsel dan menawar di warung, warung menuntut potongan ke distributor, distributor menahan pesanan bulan berikutnya.
segments.tr: But on the ground: consumers take photos of mobile screens and bargain at small shops, shops demand discounts from the distributor, the distributor holds back the next month's orders.

segments.src: Ini **konflik multisaluran** — merek bersaing dengan mitranya sendiri memakai produk yang sama.
segments.tr: This is **multichannel conflict** — the brand competes with its own partner using the exact same product.

segments.src: Pihak mana yang lebih kuat?
segments.tr: Which party is stronger?

segments.src: Merek punya kekuatan referensi dan akses langsung ke konsumen.
segments.tr: The brand has referent power and direct access to consumers.

segments.src: Distributor punya kekuatan keahlian berupa jaringan warung yang tidak bisa dibangun dalam semalam.
segments.tr: The distributor has expert power in the form of a small shop network that cannot be built overnight.

segments.src: Kalau merek memaksa lewat kekuatan paksaan, jaringan warung bisa lepas — dan saat promosi online berhenti, tidak ada lagi rak yang menampung produknya.
segments.tr: If the brand forces its way through coercive power, the shop network can break away — and when online promotions stop, there are no longer shelves holding its products.

segments.src: Penyelesaian yang lazim dipakai perusahaan konsumen di Indonesia:
segments.tr: Common resolutions used by consumer companies in Indonesia:

segments.src: 1. **Bedakan isi per saluran.** Marketplace menjual paket isi 5 atau varian edisi khusus; warung menjual satuan. Konsumen tidak lagi membandingkan barang yang persis sama.
segments.tr: 1. **Differentiate content per channel.** The marketplace sells 5-packs or special edition variants; small shops sell individually. Consumers no longer compare identical items.

segments.src: 2. **Tetapkan disiplin harga.** Harga eceran tertinggi diumumkan resmi dan berlaku untuk semua saluran, termasuk toko resmi merek.
segments.tr: 2. **Establish price discipline.** Maximum retail prices are officially announced and apply to all channels, including the brand's official store.

segments.src: 3. **Bagi hasil, bukan rebut hasil.** Pesanan online di wilayah Jabodetabek dikirim dari gudang distributor, dan distributor tetap menerima komisi per pak.
segments.tr: 3. **Profit sharing, not profit grabbing.** Online orders in Greater Jakarta are shipped from the distributor's warehouse, and the distributor still receives a commission per pack.

segments.src: 4. **Buka datanya.** Merek membagikan data pembeli online per kecamatan, distributor memakainya untuk menambah titik warung baru.
segments.tr: 4. **Open the data.** The brand shares online buyer data per sub-district, which the distributor uses to add new shop locations.

segments.src: Hasil yang diharapkan bukan "nol konflik", melainkan konflik yang berpindah dari perebutan pembeli yang sama menjadi perdebatan sehat soal cara menambah pembeli baru.
segments.tr: The expected result is not "zero conflict", but rather conflict shifting from fighting over the same buyers to healthy debates on how to add new buyers.

segments.src: ## Ringkasan 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Saluran distribusi terdiri atas perusahaan-perusahaan mandiri yang saling membutuhkan tetapi tidak berbagi keuntungan, sehingga konflik adalah hal struktural — bukan kecelakaan.
segments.tr: 1. Distribution channels consist of independent companies that need each other but do not share profits, making conflict structural — not an accident.

segments.src: 2. Hasil konflik ditentukan oleh sumber kekuatan (imbalan, paksaan, sah, keahlian, referensi), dan di ritel modern kekuatan itu bergeser ke pihak yang memegang akses langsung ke konsumen serta datanya.
segments.tr: 2. Conflict outcomes are determined by sources of power (reward, coercive, legitimate, expert, referent), and in modern retail that power shifts to those holding direct access to consumers and their data.

segments.src: 3. Menekan mitra memberi kemenangan cepat; kejelasan peran, kompensasi lintas saluran, dan berbagi data memberi kemitraan yang bertahan.
segments.tr: 3. Pressuring partners gives quick wins; role clarity, cross-channel compensation, and data sharing provide lasting partnerships.

segments.src: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri
segments.tr: ## ✅ Self Quiz

segments.src: **1.** Sebuah produsen mengancam menghentikan pasokan kepada distributor yang tidak mencapai target.
segments.tr: **1.** A manufacturer threatens to stop supply to a distributor who fails to meet targets.

segments.src: Sumber kekuatan apa yang sedang dipakai?
segments.tr: What source of power is being used?

segments.src: - A. Kekuatan imbalan
segments.tr: - A. Reward power

segments.src: - B. Kekuatan paksaan
segments.tr: - B. Coercive power

segments.src: - C. Kekuatan keahlian
segments.tr: - C. Expert power

segments.src: - D. Kekuatan referensi
segments.tr: - D. Referent power

segments.src: **2.** Dua distributor resmi merek yang sama saling menyerobot wilayah penjualan di Surabaya.
segments.tr: **2.** Two official distributors of the same brand encroach on each other's sales territories in Surabaya.

segments.src: Jenis konflik apa ini?
segments.tr: What type of conflict is this?

segments.src: - A. Konflik vertikal
segments.tr: - A. Vertical conflict

segments.src: - B. Konflik horizontal
segments.tr: - B. Horizontal conflict

segments.src: - C. Konflik multisaluran
segments.tr: - C. Multichannel conflict

segments.src: - D. Bukan konflik saluran
segments.tr: - D. Not a channel conflict

segments.src: **3.** (Benar / Salah) Semua konflik dalam saluran distribusi bersifat merugikan dan harus dihilangkan sepenuhnya.
segments.tr: **3.** (True / False) All conflicts in distribution channels are harmful and must be completely eliminated.

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Terms

segments.src: - **Saluran distribusi** — rangkaian pihak independen yang memindahkan produk dari produsen ke konsumen akhir.
segments.tr: - **Distribution channel** — a series of independent parties that move products from producers to end consumers.

segments.src: - **Kekuatan saluran (channel power)** — kemampuan satu anggota saluran memengaruhi keputusan anggota lain.
segments.tr: - **Channel power** — the ability of one channel member to influence the decisions of other members.

segments.src: - **Konflik multisaluran** — benturan kepentingan antara dua saluran atau lebih milik merek yang sama saat memperebutkan pembeli yang sama.
segments.tr: - **Multichannel conflict** — a clash of interests between two or more channels belonging to the same brand when fighting for the same buyers.

segments.src: - **Tujuan superordinat** — sasaran bersama yang lebih besar dari kepentingan tiap pihak, dipakai untuk meredam konflik.
segments.tr: - **Superordinate goals** — shared objectives larger than each party's interests, used to suppress conflict.

segments.src: - **Konflik disfungsional** — konflik yang kadarnya melewati batas sehat sehingga menurunkan kinerja seluruh saluran.
segments.tr: - **Dysfunctional conflict** — conflict whose level exceeds healthy limits, thereby degrading the performance of the entire channel.

segments.src: *Jawaban: 1) B — ancaman menghentikan pasokan adalah pemberian kerugian, ciri kekuatan paksaan; bila yang ditawarkan justru bonus rabat, itu kekuatan imbalan.
segments.tr: *Answers: 1) B — the threat to stop supply is the infliction of harm, a characteristic of coercive power; if a rebate bonus were offered instead, that would be reward power.

segments.src: 2) B — keduanya berada pada tingkat yang sama dalam rantai, sehingga tergolong konflik horizontal.
segments.tr: 2) B — both are at the same level in the chain, thus classified as horizontal conflict.

segments.src: 3) Salah — konflik berkadar wajar dapat memicu perbaikan layanan dan efisiensi; yang perlu dikendalikan adalah konflik disfungsional.*
segments.tr: 3) False — conflict at a moderate level can trigger service improvements and efficiency; what needs to be controlled is dysfunctional conflict.*
